day.headline: A Goat day — Rabbit and Pig are in step.

reasons: Horse pairs with Goat — a harmonious day
signs.message: That switch you fight every night. Ten minutes, sorted today.

reasons: Rabbit and Goat share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: a late nap that ruined things
signs.message: Yesterday's five o'clock nap cost you the night. Stay upright.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: First round's yours as usual. Get it in before anyone offers.

reasons: Rooster sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Sit in that thing and the evening's over. Stay standing.

reasons: Pig and Goat share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Hot water in it now. Later it wipes out clean.

reasons: Goat's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Voice is shot from yesterday. Type it instead, rest it.

reasons: Snake sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Slide it through the return slot on your way past.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: They're running behind. Order yours, don't sit there waiting politely.

reasons: Ox opposes Goat — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: being early and having nothing to do
signs.message: Twenty minutes early with nothing to fill. Ideal, do nothing.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You trailed off mid-thought. Let it hang, nobody's waiting.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: an album meant to be heard
signs.message: The record someone swore you'd love. Not tonight, it keeps.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You settled this days ago. Nothing to announce, nothing to revisit.
